selection_before_values: all station identities in the named MFFP dataset whose metadata support freshwater river sites and test years 2010 through 2020; do not select using observed temperatures or model performance; freeze roster before qualification
prior_contact: audit exact station identifiers, prior cache and source rosters, geometry and hydrologic group relationships before scoring; absent identity or ambiguous overlap is not independent confirmation
reference_requirement: for each day, independently establish the expected sample cadence, unique timestamp coverage of the complete defined 24-hour day, usable nonestimated quality status, instrument and daylight/time-zone convention; one value per daily date is not sufficient
reference_years: at least four eligible complete calendar years per station, with three other complete years for leave-one-year-out local fitting
current_metadata_caveat: current RivTemp protocol allows daily summaries when retained subdaily observations exceed 90%; a published paper describes an all-hours requirement for its study; the exact rules, version and per-day completeness evidence for this release are not established
access_caveat: At plan creation only public catalog pages had been browsed; no dataset download, account registration or email had been performed. Site use is subject to the provider terms; subsequent acquisition is recorded separately in acquisition.json.
rights_caveat: DataStream page presents ODC-BY attribution and a separate disclaimer restricting database transfer; redistribution, derived records and reviewer-access permissions need clarification
assessment: unqualified lead only; no data selection, reconstruction scores or new independent validation claimed

access_note_correction.original_text: RivTemp direct database access uses requested credentials; the DataStream download button states access implies agreement to its terms; no account created, terms accepted, data retrieved or email sent
access_note_correction.reason: The site terms state that browsing itself is subject to its terms; the earlier statement that no terms were accepted was too broad. Selection, year, completeness and no-outcome rules are unchanged.
